candidate_binding: Runner registers exactly one FormalCandidateProgress accepted identity; handoff.slice_revision must equal its candidate_revision and handoff.candidate_digest must equal its candidate_digest
runner_builder_operation: protocol_list_platform_artifacts exposes observed metadata; protocol_build_acceptance_stage_handoff accepts exactly three stage->{tool,arguments,artifact_path} selections and returns handoff_json/handoff_digest; Protocol sends that JSON unchanged

digest_rules.handoff: canonical compact JSON SHA-256; set the self field handoff_digest to null and set every nested ticket_digest ref to null in the preimage
digest_rules.receipt: canonical compact JSON SHA-256; set the self field receipt_digest to null and set every nested ticket_digest ref to null in the preimage
digest_rules.model_state: canonical compact JSON SHA-256 over schema_version r2-3-005-model-state/v1 and the six identity fields
digest_rules.delivery: Runner compares the canonical compact handoff bytes to the exact Protocol->Coordinator Team Transport delivery digest
digest_rules.platform_artifact: Runner/Codex Runtime hashes the canonical completed ontology_platform MCP tool name together with its arguments as request_digest and canonical result envelope bytes as response_digest; each completion is immutable at evidence/platform-responses/<request_digest>-<response_digest>.json, so different tools cannot alias identical arguments/results and repeated requests with changed results remain distinct
